title: NYYVEXXX's PvP Utils
description: Its just a pvp utils mod I made for fun  :)
body:
PvP Utils is a client-side Minecraft mod designed to enhance your PvP experience without giving players an unfair advantage.

This mod is made for players who want useful PvP HUD features like keystrokes, CPS, ping, and FPS displays while keeping the gameplay fair and vanilla-friendly.

### Features:
- Customizable keystrokes display
- Supports additional keyboard keys
- CPS counter
- Ping display
- FPS display

This mod is currently in alpha and more features will be added in future updates.
AI tools were used for code review and quality improvements.
